name: dummy-repo/environment
install:
node --version
corepack enable >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
ROOT="$(cd .. && pwd)"
echo "Repos root: $ROOT"
for d in "$ROOT"/*/; do
  [ -d "${d}.git" ] || continue
  if [ -f "${d}.bazelversion" ]; then
    echo "Verifying Bazel toolchain in $(basename "$d")"
    ( cd "$d" && npx -y @bazel/bazelisk@1.19.0 version )
  fi
done
echo "install: complete"
